How TTMS powers Smart Routing

Build routes that balance delivery speed, driver safety, and operating cost. TTMS adjusts plans with live road context and service priorities. This service emphasizes multi-stop route planning with lane and time-window logic.

  • Multi-stop route planning with lane and time-window logic
  • Live rerouting based on traffic, weather, and operational constraints
  • Driver-aware routing that respects HOS and rest requirements
  • Service-priority rules for premium, standard, and recovery loads
  • Route scorecards for distance, fuel, risk, and delay probability
  • Integrated customer ETA updates linked to route state changes

User Safety & Care

Routes avoid known risk corridors when safer alternatives exist. Driver rest and legal HOS windows are enforced in planning.

  • Routes avoid known risk corridors when safer alternatives exist
  • Driver rest and legal HOS windows are enforced in planning
  • Dispatch can intervene before a risky delay becomes a safety event
  • Customers receive realistic windows that reduce pressure on drivers

Plan

Smart Routing Audit & Compliance Reporting

Smart Routing data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can plan route templates by lane profile, stop density, and safety policy and maintain audit-ready records.

  • Smart Routing events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
